responsibility: Header providing GNU Modula-2 tree-node accessor macros for Modula-2-specific or front-end-used GCC tree forms such as TRY_BLOCK, HANDLER, STMT_EXPR, and EXPR_STMT. It does not define new tree codes itself; instead it centralizes the operand and flag access conventions that neighboring gm2 source files use when constructing, traversing, or pretty-printing Modula-2 trees.
same_name_distinction: Accessor/header side of the m2-tree stem: it defines macros such as TRY_STMTS, TRY_HANDLERS, HANDLER_* and EXPR_STMT_EXPR for working with tree nodes, while m2-tree.def is the tree-code registration fragment that adds SET_TYPE.
